Hildegard 0.1.2 is a pre-alpha. It adds safety checks, one-step Hugging Face sign-in, coding agents that stay within each provider's terms, and Runpod GPUs. It also fixes what device testing of 0.1.1 found.

## Install

- **macOS and Linux:** `curl -fsSL https://dbaney.com/hildegard/install.sh | sh`
- **Windows (PowerShell):** `irm https://dbaney.com/hildegard/install.ps1 | iex`
- **Desktop app:** pick your system's download below, or from [dbaney.com/hildegard](https://dbaney.com/hildegard/).

## New

- **No sexual content.** Prompts, models, LoRAs and model files are checked before anything renders, and every frame of every take is checked after. Refused takes show as "Refused". See `docs/safety.md`.
- **Hugging Face sign-in with no setup.** Sign in from the browser, or with a device code over ssh. If this computer is already signed in with the `hf` command, Hildegard offers to reuse that token in one click. Tokens stay in the system keychain.
- **Coding agents within their providers' terms.** `hildegard agents` runs Claude Code, Codex and OMP with Hildegard's tools. A Claude or ChatGPT plan runs only in its own app, only when you start the run, and at a gentle pace. Automation and schedules use API keys. See `docs/agent-terms.md`.
- **Skills and quality checks.** `hildegard skills install` adds film, editing, photo, art, sound, setup and cloud skills for your coding agent. `hildegard review <file>` checks a take for black or frozen frames, flicker, clipping, exposure and loudness.
- **Runpod GPUs.** `hildegard cloud runpod up` rents a GPU with your own Runpod key. It joins your devices, and it stops itself when idle.
- **App icons** now match each system: the macOS squircle, the Windows plate, and a Studio favicon that follows light and dark mode.

## Fixed

- A second install, or a second data folder, no longer stops the Hildegard that's already running or takes its port. Each home's server is its own, and a new one starts on the next free port and says which.
- **Windows:** upgrading while Hildegard runs from a copied app folder (exFAT or FAT32 drives) now stops it first, so the old folder can be replaced.
- **Doctor:** it no longer asks for a Hugging Face account while your takes render on a paired device.

## Known limits

- Macs don't render on their own GPU yet. Pair a Mac with a computer that has an NVIDIA or AMD GPU
  (`hildegard choir join`).
- The Windows and macOS apps aren't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen and macOS Gatekeeper ask you to confirm the first launch.
- Hugging Face Jobs and Colab GPUs aren't supported yet.
- LTX models follow Lightricks' license: free under $10M yearly revenue, and not for products that compete with
  Lightricks. Wan 2.2 is Apache-2.0.
